inspection_summary: Portable synthetic foundation only. Official current metadata and renderer source establish separate candidate tuples; no claim that peer ranges alone admit a renderer or that headless tests prove native source availability. Scope13 package files plus receipt; no core, production native, manifest plan, decision or dependency edits outside package. Independent review lifecycle race corrected by retaining active ownership during pending close and waiting for acknowledgement before successor acquisition. Recursive sorted test discovery replaces foundation-only hardcoding. Synchronous loading notifications now recheck disposed/generation/cancelled scope before operation acquisition, finalizing stale owned scopes. Three reentry regressions prove zero stale reads for cancel/dispose and one latest read for bounded refresh reentry.
limitations: Node24 darwin-arm64 headless synthetic checks only; actual React/Effect singleton resolution, rendered components/hooks, browser, RN/Hermes/macOS/native Release SDK/bridge/bundle and accessibility are unexecuted.
Operation adapter must cooperate with cancellation and register owned finalizers before suspension; model cannot force an arbitrary external promise to settle.
Conservative import-free leaf boundary guard is not a general TypeScript security parser; neutral bundle graph and strict ES-only types also checked.
Source metadata hashes are fetched primary bytes; registry tarball/native artifacts/signatures not installed or independently verified.
No source domain grant, native available capability, capture, persisted state, health values, credentials, provider connection or user-data access.
